requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Each board presents a recognisable greeting letter, small-envelope front and keepsake front in proportions corresponding to 148 × 210, 162 × 114 and 105 × 148 mm respectively. The three boards offer distinguishable graphic approaches rather than repeated versions of one approach. Presentation scale may vary while each piece retains its proportions.

The selection sheet unambiguously identifies one of the three supplied directions. The masters develop that choice, and the opening presentation page identifies the identical choice. The documented process places selection before development; export timestamps are not required. An unnamed choice, conflicting selection or unrelated master system fails.

A single page identifies and explains the chosen direction, defines one governing motif rule, gives actionable spacing guidance, lists palette codes and specifies type families and weights. Every printed text level has an explicit priority, the piece or location carrying it, and a minimum point size. Missing specifications or vague substitutes that cannot guide production fail.

Compare the document pages with the selected specification: motif application, spacing, palette and typography must conform across all seven masters, allowing adaptations expressly permitted by the rules. The rules sheet records all face dimensions. Both the use board and presentation reproduce those dimensions and caption the governing motif rule and palette codes without omissions or contradictions.

Inspect the document pages and physical page geometry for eleven faces: greeting and thank-you 148 × 210 mm; note 105 × 148 mm; small-envelope faces 162 × 114 mm; long-envelope faces 220 × 110 mm; postcard faces 148 × 105 mm; keepsake faces 105 × 148 mm. Each paired face occupies its own page. Provide 3 mm bleed beyond trim and keep printed wording at least 5 mm inside trim. Both letters retain an uninterrupted 110 × 150 mm writing rectangle; note and keepsake back retain uninterrupted 75 × 95 mm rectangles, freely positioned. With coordinates measured from trimmed upper-left corners as x,y,width,height in mm, reserve small-envelope recipient (58,40,88,46), stamp (126,8,28,26), sender (12,76,74,25); long-envelope recipient (108,40,90,44), stamp (184,8,28,26), sender (12,73,78,25); postcard-back message (8,10,62,85), recipient (80,43,60,45), stamp (112,8,28,26). Writing surfaces must remain light, quiet and continuous; fine low-contrast guides are allowed. Recipient, sender and stamp rectangles remain blank paper. Missing faces, incorrect physical geometry or encroaching artwork fail; no exact raster pixel count is required.

The delivered master pages are ready for repeated personal use: no supplied sample message, filled address, memory entry or demonstration signature occupies a protected region. Optional identity wording outside protected regions is acceptable. Filled demonstrations must not replace the blank master pages.
Each envelope document depicts its closed exterior front and back. A flattened cutting net, unfolded flap layout or interior view cannot substitute for either required exterior face.

Within each document, front and back have identical physical trim dimensions and matching portrait or landscape orientation. A rotated or differently sized reverse fails even when its area is similar.

Front and back of each piece visibly belong to the selected system through related typography, motif treatment or spacing. Their compositions may differ to serve their respective functions and protected regions. An unrelated reverse or a continuity treatment that invades a protected region fails.

The landscape A2 board contains identifiable reproductions of all eleven completed master faces, the filled greeting, both filled small-envelope faces and a portrait phone composition using the same greeting-and-envelope arrangement. Its captions identify physical face dimensions, motif rule and palette codes. Scaling and arrangement may change for presentation, but missing faces, substituted artwork or an unrelated phone composition fail.

Read the filled greeting and labelled presentation copies in order: 'Dear Jules,'; 'The rain finally stopped, and the balcony basil has found its way back. I kept thinking of our slow walk after the station cafe closed. Write when you have a quiet hour.'; 'With love,'; 'Rowan'. Read the recipient record as Jules North / 18 Lantern Lane / Fable Harbour and the back sender record as Rowan Vale / 6 Paper Court / Fable Harbour. All wording must be complete and correctly assigned; line wrapping may vary. The greeting stays inside its writing rectangle, and addresses stay inside their respective protected rectangles. Compare letterforms, relative letter size, line spacing and signature with 04-rowan-handwriting.png. Generic handwriting without the reference's identifying features, changed base artwork or clipped text fails.

Do not penalize masters for omitting collection or owner wording. Where included, those identifiers remain outside protected writing rectangles. Filled greeting demonstrations use Rowan as the signature inside the message region; replacing it with Rowan Vale fails.

Review the entire ten-second portrait animation against the board's phone composition. The opening frame shows the completed greeting; the closing frame shows both small-envelope faces. Artwork and wording remain faithful throughout, while motion and transitions may vary. The presentation places the actual opening and closing keyframes beside the matching static composition. Wrong duration, missing endpoint content, altered artwork or wording, or mismatched presentation frames fails.

requirementChecks.criteria: Count at least eight pages and locate all eleven finished faces. A face-by-face map identifies each face's physical dimensions, applicable protected-region measurements and actual printed wording, explicitly indicating absent wording where appropriate. Label filled demonstration copies and preserve their corresponding masters' artwork and region geometry underneath added handwriting. Missing faces, incomplete mappings or demonstrations based on different masters fail.

Find visible, recognisable reuse of every listed source, including all three alternatives, the selection and specification sheet, every master document and the use board. Resizing and presentation framing are acceptable if source content remains identifiable. Textual mentions alone, replacement designs or omitted sources fail; video keyframe fidelity is assessed in the manual video check.

Record that no particular theme, color palette or font is prescribed. Judge conformity to the designer's selected rules without inventing stylistic requirements. The additional thank-you, brief-note and keepsake samples provide tone or optional demonstration content; their printing is not mandatory.
